prompts.solar: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent native game building sprite. Input image 1 is the old pair of Solar/Lunar archway entrances being replaced; use its color identity only. Input image 2 is the architectural/game-art style reference. Create ONE complete, magnificent enclosed assembly-hall BUILDING, with substantial visible roof, solid front and side walls, large lit windows, broad stepped stone foundation and a single recessed entrance in the center of the FRONT wall. The hall must visibly be a full room-sized building, never a freestanding arch or gateway. Slightly elevated perfectly centered straight-on orthographic RPG camera, visible roof plus front, left and right symmetric, no diagonal/isometric camera. Similar crisp detailed pixel-game rendering and dark outlines to reference 2. This is a major landmark hall, dignified and readable at 384 by384 native pixels, large coherent masses and restrained detail. Square composition with the whole building including roof emblem and base fully visible, generous clear transparent margins on every side. Building subject approximately square width-to-height. The centered open double doorway is about ONE THIRD of the building width and opens onto a warmly/coolly lit interior with tiny rows of chairs visible beyond; it meets the bottom center of the building, with no long stairs or landscape below. Leave a plain horizontal cornice immediately above the entrance for a separately drawn label. Absolutely no text, letters, wordmarks, characters, external signs, floating ornaments, surrounding scenery, or cast shadow outside the building. Real transparent background, not a rendered checkerboard. Preserve actual alpha. Change the original gate silhouette completely into the specified solid enclosed building. Solar theme: luminous amber and honey-gold stone, ivory architectural walls, copper-orange ribbed half-dome roof covering the building body, a large sculpted radiant golden SUN at the dome crown, subtly layered sun-ray cornices, warm amber-lit windows. Small integrated flower planters beside entrance, elegant paired cylindrical corner towers contained in the footprint. The sunset gold and orange are richer than reference 2, no crimson Leo palette and no lions. Let the central high dome and sun emblem dominate the upper half, the enclosed glazed lobby and doorway fill the lower half.
